name: Jørgen Røjel
role: The doctor. SOE's planner for the bridges

known.fact: Junior doctor at Randers Hospital since August 1943, ordered by SOE (Geisler) to plan the bridges and stay away from every other illegal circle.
known.source: CHARACTERS.md v1 (Straarup, RAHS 2020; research notes; Knud Birk memoir; Randers Kommune info board)

known.fact: Goes to bed convinced the fuses have failed, hears the first blast from his pillow.
known.source: CHARACTERS.md v1 (Straarup, RAHS 2020; research notes; Knud Birk memoir; Randers Kommune info board)

known.fact: Warned by Dr Thorup Petersen on the morning of 20 Nov that the arrests have begun; flees to Sweden two days later.
known.source: CHARACTERS.md v1 (Straarup, RAHS 2020; research notes; Knud Birk memoir; Randers Kommune info board)

known.fact: Lives to 90 and writes the books everyone else quotes.
known.source: CHARACTERS.md v1 (Straarup, RAHS 2020; research notes; Knud Birk memoir; Randers Kommune info board)

known.fact: Called Harvy Jensen a traitor for 27 years, read the case file in 2000, and wasn't sure any more.
known.source: CHARACTERS.md v1 (Straarup, RAHS 2020; research notes; Knud Birk memoir; Randers Kommune info board)
